headline: A 2015 law extends dozens of expiring VA health care, benefits, and homelessness programs for one more year or so.
what_it_does: This law keeps many Department of Veterans Affairs programs running that were set to expire. It extends health care authorities such as copayment collection and caregiver support, plus benefit programs like housing loan rules and education advisory work. It also extends homelessness programs, transportation grants, and several facility and reporting requirements. Most extensions run through fiscal year 2016 or December 31, 2016.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans receiving VA hospital or nursing home care
who_it_affects.how: Rules on copayments for hospital and nursing home care and nursing home care for certain service-connected veterans are extended.
Assistance and support services for caregivers are funded through fiscal year 2016.

who_it_affects.group: Homeless veterans and veterans at risk of homelessness
who_it_affects.how: Reintegration, housing assistance, supportive services, and referral and counseling programs are extended.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans with service-connected disabilities who use specially adapted housing
who_it_affects.how: Temporary eligibility expansion for certain veterans with difficulty ambulating is extended through fiscal year 2016.
Grants to veterans service organizations for transportation are extended through fiscal year 2016.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans seeking VA home loans or facing foreclosure
who_it_affects.how: Specified housing loan provisions, including how property net value is calculated at foreclosure, are extended through fiscal year 2016.

who_it_affects.group: Women veterans newly separated from service
who_it_affects.how: A pilot program offering counseling in retreat settings is extended through December 31, 2016.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans in vocational rehabilitation or education programs
who_it_affects.how: Transportation to VA facilities and fee multipliers paid to schools for enrollment reports are extended.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted September 30, 2015; the extended authorities run through fiscal year 2016 or fiscal year 2017 for the DOD-VA Joint Demonstration Fund, or through December 31, 2016 for others.
